results.basis: REGISTER: RESEARCHED 2026-10-24 (HANDOFF §3 item 2). INSTAT's own monthly HICP release (Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices, September 2026, for publication 16/10/2026) reconciles its figures with Eurostat's in footnote 1: INSTAT publishes the indices unrounded and Eurostat publishes the same indices rounded to two decimal places, so the two can differ only by rounding. That is the target's own publisher stating that the Albanian HICP Eurostat publishes is INSTAT's index, which is the input relation. WEAKER THAN SWEDEN'S: SCB's page says Eurostat publishes 'after the individual countries have submitted their respective indices'; INSTAT's footnote implies the transmission rather than stating it. Albania is an EU candidate, so this is Eurostat's database series for Albania, not an input to the EU aggregate. ROUTE: INSTAT's own PDF (HTTP 200), read in the cloud container with TLS verification on; quote verbatim from the PDF's text layer, which renders the document's commas as full stops.
results.evidenceQuote: INSTAT publishes unrounded indices. while EUROSTAT publishes indices rounded to two decimal places.

targetReport.title: Consumer Price Index / Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP), Albania
targetReport.description: INSTAT's monthly consumer price index and, since 2017, its harmonised index. INSTAT's HICP page: "In January 2017 INSTAT published for the first time the Harmonised indices of consumer prices" and "The HICP weights are constructed in accordance with the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2016/79. The HICP weights reflect the structure of the FMCE (domestic concept)." Its CPI page: "Starting from February 2026, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) is calculated according to the ECOICOP 2018 classification."
targetReport.cadence_note: Monthly releases ('Consumer Price Index, May 2026' and the monthly HICP publications on INSTAT's site).
